Text tools

Draft undo/redo, keyboard layout correction, find/replace, whitespace cleanup, text statistics, text comparison and combining selected messages into a draft. Chat menu → Lunagram tools; select several messages → Copy.
Reading tools
Reader with search and paragraph navigation, explicit read-aloud through an installed Android engine, and temporary keyword folding in the channel feed. Message menu → Tools; Feed → menu.
Links and pack lists
Tracking cleanup with preview, local address inspection, per-chat link previews, QR from text, copying with source and transferring sticker pack lists. Inspection does not guarantee a site is safe.
Local workspace

Text templates, bookmark collections, private checklists, draft versions, saved chat searches, reading markers and local group/channel aliases: Chat menu → Lunagram tools. Proxy labels and groups: Proxy settings → information button. Data stays on this device; saved data remains readable after expiry.
Media tools

Single-file cache cleanup, file details and SHA-256, copying a photo, audio/round-video timestamp bookmarks, A–B repeat and a playback sleep timer. Protected and disappearing media are excluded. Message menu or audio player → Media tools.
